感谢试用！中文、English、日本語均可；填写适用的部分即可。
Thanks for trying Miniature World. Use any language and skip fields that do not apply.

这是公开 Issue。不要填写密钥、账号、私人文件路径或未经允许的照片。图片可选。
This issue is public. Do not include credentials, account details, private file paths or photos you may not share. Images are optional.

### 使用环境 / Environment

- 宿主 / Host: Codex / Claude Code / other
- 系统 / OS:
- Skill 版本或来源 / Skill version or source (if known):

### 从哪里发现的 / How did you find it? (optional)

例如导航、文章、朋友或搜索；填渠道名称即可。
For example: a directory, article, friend or search. A channel name is enough.

### 这次走到了哪一步 / How far did you get?

- [ ] 下载并安装 / Downloaded and installed
- [ ] 新会话加载 Skill / Loaded the Skill in a fresh session
- [ ] 看到文字方案 / Received text-only ideas
- [ ] 生成一张图，或在已有工具中使用提示词 / Generated an image or used the prompt in an existing tool
- [ ] 查看结果 / Reviewed the result

### 输入与结果 / Input and result

- 物件名称，或照片的文字说明 / Object name or description of your photo:
- 发送的请求 / Your request:
- 实际出现了什么；若卡住，在哪一步 / What happened; where did you get stuck?
- 若生成了图，你第一眼觉得“这是什么场景” / If you made an image, what scene did you see at first glance?

### 最值得改的一点 / One thing to improve

例如安装不清楚、没有生图工具、故事读不出、商品改变或人物太大。
For example: unclear installation, no image tool, unreadable story, altered product or oversized figures.
